1) Reissue from a Redwood account with Zoom link (cleanest) — attach new ICS, include passcode in body.
2) Keep original event but add a supplemental Zoom event (duplicate time) and mark it as "Join if Meet fails" — avoids organizer transfer.

I prefer option 1 for first-time demos to reduce attendee confusion. If we do option 1 we'll:
- Create Zoom meeting with passcode 7392
- Send redwood-zoom-fallback.ics from marissa@redwoodinference.com
- Put a one-line note in the event description: "If you see no Meet button, use Zoom link below — passcode 7392"
